title: The Lives You Didn't Choose
core_idea: The parallel worlds idea can be used as a reflective tool: imagining other paths to honour the one being lived.
text: Some physicists have explored the idea of many worlds, and some spiritual thinkers imagine parallel lives unfolding side by side. Neither is something we can visit or confirm. But the idea can be a gentle mirror. Picture, for a moment, a version of you who made another choice. Moved to another city. Said yes instead of no. Feel what comes up. Longing? Relief? Curiosity? Those feelings can tell you something real about what matters to you now. You don't have to live every possible life. Perhaps it's enough to bring a little of what you admire in that other you into the life that's yours.
description: A reflection on the idea of parallel worlds as a gentle mirror, helping you notice what matters in the life you are living now.
